name: 非表示の状態列一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate ONE Japanese Lighthouse catalog component LH09-0007 非表示の状態列一覧.
Hierarchy: ORIGINAL image1 controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, opticalstroke, alignment, spacing and smallcontrol anatomy. Japanese mock image2 is SECONDARY for wording/layout: do not reproduce its rough substitute icons or omitted disclosurechevron. Image3 supplies official white surface/softelevation style only, never buscontent.
Compact standalone panel with small header: original tiny downward disclosuretriangle then Japanese「非表示の列」. Exactly three separate rounded white rows underneath, matching ORIGINAL grouping andspacing. Row1 small dotted-outline circle then「未整理」. Row2 small slatefilled circular marker containing a white thin X then「取り消し」. Row3 same slatefilled circle with white thin X then「重複」. Original cancellation/duplicate markers are filledgray withwhiteX, NOT the mock's hollow circledcross. Use authentic fine icon anatomy andconsistent opticalsize, nottextcharacters. Restore headerchevron omittedby mock.
Pure white #FFFFFF outercanvas androwbackgrounds; fine neutral outlines, small8px rowcorners andvery softdownwardshadow; no parentcard wrapper, no broadmint/grayfill. Mainlabels #1D1D1D, utilityicons #526173, neutraldottedcircle. No selectedstate, primaryaction or meaningful categoryaccent: remainneutral, do not add greenbutton or gradientbar. Match compact220x188logicalpixel arrangement, alignedrows andshortgaps.
Typography locked Meiryo Regular14/24 rowlabels, Regular12/16 smallheader, zerotracking. Normalweight, notbold. Exact Japanese above, no addedcount, explanatorycopy, toggle, buttons, rows or English. Tightly framed singlecomponent. Staticrastercandidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画像全体・個別切抜き・通常/390幅モックを実見。非表示の列/未整理/取り消し/重複を確認。原画像の開閉三角と取消/重複の塗り円+白Xを復元、未整理は点線円。色の意味がないためスレートと白へ統一。文字欠落・切れ無し、細い境界と抑制した影。原ベクター/書体の厳密同一性は未証明。エージェント目視確認であり所有者承認・新ネイティブ・アプリ実装とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
